paragraphs.text: The Tivan Desert is a desert in Jamuraa , and the largest desert on Dominaria . It covers almost all of the southeastern subcontinent of Jamuura. The southern edge is separated from the ocean by the Mayar Mountains .

The desert was formed by several millennial long-lasting Cyclones that were actually planar portals to Rabiah , that deposited enormous amounts of sand on the continent. They also transported many inhabitants from Rabiah to Jamuura, including humans , Djinn and Efreet , who then colonized the continent.
The Tivan Desert is infamous for its strange property laws.

Teferi discovered that his friend Urza had left behind a series of devices and magical artifacts that could be of help in repairing the Zhalfirin time rift. With help from his daughter Niambi , the Weatherlight crew , and the Gatewatch , he retrieved one of these artifacts, a delicate dark crystal orb nestled in a cage of silver vines, from a giant monument in the Tivan Desert.
